title: Depression survivor leaves note of hope at Bukidnon bridge

blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A printed note of encouragement left anonymously on a post at Atugan Bridge in Impasugong, Bukidnon, went viral on Monday, urging the public to show kindness and empathy after recent fatal jumps at the site. Written in Cebuano and English by a self-described survivor of severe depression, the note was taped to a concrete post along the 64.5-meter-high bridge —among Mindanao’s highest—and included a mobile number for anyone in crisis who needs someone to talk to. Passersby photographed the note and shared it online, where the message quickly drew widespread reactions. READ: The end of depression In […]...
